thread:
lina: seeing SSO 400s for a handful of customers since 02:00 UTC. app logs show 'RelayState missing' and SAML response rejected.
omar: which proxy path? any recent changes to sso-proxy or nginx?
lina: proxy v2.4 rolled at 01:50 for small header normalization change. sample rejection:\n```nSAMLValidationError: missing RelayState for InResponseTo reqid=abc123\n```
tara: odd. our proxy should forward RelayState untouched. could it be truncated by load-balancer header size limits?
omar: LB edge had a config tweak around 01:45 increasing header compression; ops rolled that back at 02:10 but effects could coincide.
lina: also seeing SCIM errors around same time: `decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException (envelope ctx mismatch)` when provisioning linked accounts.
tara: that suggests encryption-context key mismatch. any KMS alias changes this morning?
omar: ops did alias swap for extid-key at 00:30 but there was a partial rewrap job that flagged ~00:42. rewrap status=PARTIAL.
lina: timeline aligns: partial rewrap -> some envelopes encrypted with new key ctx -> proxy header change truncates RelayState causing SAML to reject and user retries create duplicate SCIM events -> some workers try to decrypt old envelopes with new context -> InvalidCiphertextException.
tara: mitigation plan: (1) revert header normalization permanent until we confirm RelayState passthrough; (2) re-run rewrap for flagged envelopes from snapshot; (3) run idempotency dedupe on SCIM queue to collapse duplicates.
omar: I've applied LB rollback and flagged the proxy change for rollback. deploy-bot: rollback auth-proxy v2.4 -> v2.3 triggered by @omar.
deploy-bot: rollback job rb-77 started 2026-04-02T02:12:00Z -> completed 02:14:05Z.
lina: rewrap job queued for flagged envelopes id=rekey-444. scimctl peek shows 58 failed decrypts, requeue pending.
tara: for audit we need SAML auth logs 01:30-02:30 and KMS rekey traces 00:20-01:00. also add a note: ensure rewrap uses explicit encryption-context matching per-tenant to avoid silent failures.
omar: vuln note: rewrap tooling uses libkms-go v1.3.2 which has a TTL bug; we'll upgrade to v1.4.0 in next patch.
lina: customer-impact: unable to complete first-time SSO login for ~0.3% of active sessions between 02:00-02:15 UTC. no sign of token leakage.
tara: follow-ups: (A) run rewrap job to completion; (B) run scimctl dedupe; (C) add RelayState integ test to proxy CI; (D) postmortem doc with timeline and keys: extid-key alias swap id=alias-extid-2026-04-02.
omar: will coordinate rewrap and postmortem. keeping this thread for updates.
